content.text:
## Locked prescription: staggered image catalog

**Verdict: YES — replace compact editorial rows with a staggered image grid.**  
Text-only siblings demote 11 of 15 services and contradict the existing `*-service.jpg` set (Verified in `services-index.json` + `public/images/services/`). Stagger restores hierarchy without equal 3-col wallpaper. (Observed user complaint + Proposed fix)

**Sticky text rail: YES — keep.** Soft text links, accent underline, no pill chrome. Still the jump control across four long category bands. (Verified current rail behavior)

---

### Section structure (per category)

1. Sticky rail (page-level, unchanged)
2. Category header: H2 + short description
3. One CSS Grid of **all** services in that category — every cell is a linked image card
4. No separate “featured row + list” split

PO chrome: `border-2` ink; hard shadow on hover (`ink` default, `lime` on flagship only). Cards remain interactive `<Link>`s.

---

### Card rules (all 15)

| Role | Chrome | Image | Copy |
|------|--------|-------|------|
| **Flagship** (Account Management only) | Ink fill, lime hover shadow, “Flagship” label | Required, dominant | Title + short desc + Explore |
| **Lead** (first non-flagship in other cats) | Light bg, ink border/shadow | Required | Same |
| **Standard** | Same as lead | Required | Same |

Image source: keep `/images/services/*-service.jpg` on every card. No text-only siblings.

---

### Desktop grid (`lg+`): 12 columns, `gap-4`, `grid-auto-rows: minmax(160px, auto)`

**4-item (Advertising and Growth)** — Account Management = flagship

| Slot | Span | Placement |
|------|------|-----------|
| F Account Management | `col 1/8`, `row 1/3` | Large; image-left / copy-right inside tile on `lg` |
| A PPC | `col 8/13`, `row 1/2` | Standard image-top |
| B DSP | `col 8/13`, `row 2/3` | Standard image-top |
| C Reporting | `col 1/9`, `row 3/4` | Offset wide strip (not full 12) — intentional gap `9/13` |

Pattern: L-shape flagship + stacked pair + staggered bottom strip.

**5-item (Catalog and Content)** — Listing Optimization = light lead (not ink)

| Slot | Span | Placement |
|------|------|-----------|
| L Listing SEO | `col 1/7`, `row 1/3` | Lead, image-top, taller |
| A Content Writing | `col 7/13`, `row 1/2` | Standard |
| B Visual Creativity | `col 7/13`, `row 2/3` | Standard |
| C Video Creative | `col 1/7`, `row 3/4` | Standard |
| D Catalog Mgmt | `col 7/13`, `row 3/4` | Standard |

Pattern: tall lead left, two stacked right, then even split bottom — no flat 3× wallpaper.

**3-item (Brand and Operations; Channels and DTC)** — first = light lead

| Slot | Span | Placement |
|------|------|-----------|
| L Lead | `col 1/8`, `row 1/3` | Light lead |
| A | `col 8/13`, `row 1/2` | Standard |
| B | `col 8/13`, `row 2/3` | Standard |

Same L-shape as Advertising without ink fill.

---

### Featured treatment (Account Management)

- Only ink + Flagship label + lime hard-shadow hover
- Largest cell in Advertising (`7×2` of 12)
- Remains special; other category leads get size only, not ink
- Slim hero text link to flagship can stay (Proposed; unrelated to grid)

---

### Mobile / tablet

| Breakpoint | Grid | Behavior |
|------------|------|----------|
| `<md` | 1 col | Stack order preserved; flagship/lead first; image on every card; flagship `aspect ~16/10`, others `~3/2` |
| `md–lg` | 2 col | Flagship/lead `col-span-2`; remaining in pairs |
| `lg+` | 12-col stagger | Patterns above |

No equal 3-col at any breakpoint. No marketplace filter chrome.

---

### Explicit rejects (still locked)

- Equal boring 3-col image wallpaper  
- Marketplace dashboard chrome / pill filter bars  
- Text-only compact rows  
- Purple / glow / soft SaaS cards  

---

**STATUS:** Prescription locked (Proposed for impl; layout facts Verified)  
**NEXT ACTION:** Implement grid in `services-index-categories.tsx` only after you APPROVE this prescription.
